prologue.scene_fall:
You fell for a long time. Longer than seemed possible.
Below there was nothing. Only warmth.
And a voice.
prologue.scene_god_2: Yes. I know what you did. And I know why.
prologue.scene_god_3: You lost faith. That is not the worst sin I have seen here.
prologue.scene_god_4: But you were a priest. More was expected of you. More was expected of you by yourself.
prologue.scene_god_5: In hell there are 100 souls who ended up there by mistake. Bureaucracy — even here it exists.
prologue.scene_god_6: I could fix this myself. But I won't.
prologue.scene_god_7: You will go instead of me.
prologue.scene_player_1: I won't survive there for even a minute.
prologue.scene_god_9: So I will give you what you need to survive. But I warn you — it will be painful to carry inside.
prologue.scene_god_10: Part of hell is now in you. You will feel it. You will want to use it.
prologue.scene_god_11: Don't forget who you are. Were. Want to be again.
prologue.scene_god_12: Then we will see what remains of the priest Daniel.

god_messages.demon_deal_accepted: I saw. I say nothing. I just saw.
god_messages.sin_critical: Daniel. I am still here. But you are going the wrong way.
god_messages.last_soul: One remains. The last one is always the hardest. Not because of hell — because of you.
god_messages.level_1: The Antechamber. There is still silence here. Use it — further ahead there will be none.
god_messages.level_2: You already know how to fall. Now learn to stop in time.
god_messages.level_5: The first escape. It is not shameful to run from something stronger. It is shameful not to return.
god_messages.level_10: The first guardian is behind you. Ahead is worse. But you already know that worse does not mean impossible.
god_messages.level_11: The Swamps. People don't die here from pain — from uncertainty. Check every step.
god_messages.level_20: The second Circle is done. You've changed a little. I see. I won't say if for better.
god_messages.level_21: Fire doesn't forgive the slow. But not the impatient either.
god_messages.level_25: A quarter of the way. They are already safe. Daniel — do you remember their names?
god_messages.level_30: The third Circle is behind you. Fire doesn't scare you the way it used to. That is good. And bad.
god_messages.level_40: Greed — the only sin that looks like virtue until you look back.
god_messages.level_50: Halfway. Look at yourself. Do you remember what you were like when you fell?
god_messages.level_51: Pride builds palaces and destroys people. Here — both at the same time.
god_messages.level_60: The fifth Circle. You've passed more than half. But the hardest part is not always ahead.
god_messages.level_70: The Forest of Traitors. Here everyone once betrayed someone. Even those who considered themselves righteous.
god_messages.level_75: 75 souls. Three quarters. I did not expect you to go this far.
god_messages.level_80: A machine has no soul. That is why it is more frightening than a demon.
god_messages.level_81: The Abyss. Here the laws of physics are merely suggestions.
god_messages.level_90: The ninth Circle is behind you. Daniel... I am proud. Though I shouldn't say that.
god_messages.level_91: The Throne is ahead. He knows you are here. He was waiting for someone like you.
god_messages.level_95: The Last Void. All souls you can find are here. Don't rush.
god_messages.level_99: The last room before him. Whatever happens next — you have already done more than I asked.
god_messages.level_100: I have nothing more to say. This is your moment. Not mine.
god_messages.souls_10: Ten. They are already safe. Continue.
god_messages.souls_25: A quarter of the way. Do you remember their names?
god_messages.souls_50: Halfway. They waited for you for a long time.
god_messages.souls_75: 75 souls. I did not expect you to go this far.
god_messages.souls_99: One remains. The last one is always the hardest.

upgrades.category_staff_desc: Improvements for the staff's protective strike
upgrades.staff_purity_desc: Staff strike no longer adds sin.
upgrades.vitality_desc: +1 hit before death. Base 3 hits, max 6.
upgrades.wall_grab_desc: Can grab a wall and hang for 2 seconds.
upgrades.soul_sense_desc: Souls glow faintly through platforms within 3 cells.
upgrades.soul_shield_desc: First 3 seconds after picking up a soul, enemies don't react to the player.
upgrades.quick_pickup_desc: Soul pickup is instant — no stop animation.
upgrades.soul_memory_desc: If the player dies with a soul in hand — the soul remains at the death location, does not disappear.
upgrades.faith_shield_desc: Once per level automatically blocks one enemy hit.
upgrades.cleansing_desc: -5% sin after each successfully completed level.
upgrades.recognition_desc: Fake souls and mimics are highlighted in red.
upgrades.temptation_resist_desc: An accepted demon deal gives +10% sin instead of +20%.
upgrades.quiet_step_desc: Enemies hear the player at a shorter distance. Detection range -30%.
upgrades.invisibility_desc: Once per level become invisible to enemies for 4 seconds.
upgrades.distraction_desc: Once per level emit a loud sound in the opposite direction. Enemies within 5 cells go toward the source for 3 seconds.
upgrades.decoy_desc: Once per level leave a light trail. Enemies attack the trail for 3 seconds.
upgrades.map_desc: Before level start, the general map outline is shown for 3 seconds.
upgrades.premonition_desc: Traps flash yellow 1 second before triggering.
upgrades.tracker_desc: A small arrow points toward the nearest unawakened soul.
upgrades.death_memory_desc: After death — the screen shows exactly where you died and what items were nearby.

endings.saint_desc: You came back. Not the same as you left — better.
endings.redeemed_desc: You got what you asked for. A new life. Without memory of what you did to earn it.
endings.bound_desc: Neither hell nor heaven. You know why.
endings.fallen_desc: Lucifer laughs. You saved them. But you lost yourself.
endings.traitor_desc: You stayed. But not the way you planned.
endings.rebel_desc: No one expected this. Not even Him.

souls.mimic_warning: Something is wrong with this soul
souls.1_epitaph: Got lost in the forest and never found her way home. Never harmed anyone.
souls.2_epitaph: A fisherman who saved three drowning people and sank himself. Ended up here due to a clerk's error.
souls.3_epitaph: Spent her whole life raising other people's children. Even her name was forgotten.
souls.4_epitaph: A young poet who died before he could write anything significant. The words still live inside him.
souls.5_epitaph: A doctor in a small village. She saved others, not herself.
souls.6_epitaph: A boy who saw angels and tried to tell them about his mother. No one believed him.
souls.7_epitaph: A teacher who didn't wake up one morning. She still thinks she's sleeping.
souls.8_epitaph: An old gardener. He grew a thousand trees and never cut down a living one.
souls.9_epitaph: Ended up here instead of her older sister. Asks to pass on that she holds no grudge.
souls.10_epitaph: A blacksmith. Everything he made with his hands still serves people.
souls.100_epitaph: Doesn't remember who he is. Doesn't remember where he came from. Only remembers that he loved someone very deeply.
souls.H1_story: A girl born and died on the same day. No one had time to give her a name. The name Agnes she chose herself — here, while waiting. She collected flowers that don't exist here and placed them in a vase she imagined.
souls.H20_story: The one who died and returned. Not once. Not by his own will. Eventually stayed here voluntarily — so no one else would have to die in his place. Lazarus knows you. He was waiting for you specifically.
